message: 味の秘密

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This sound... Oh no! I gotta hide!」
The whistle of a roasted sweet potato vendor echoes from out of nowhere. Instinctively, I duck into the shadow of a utility pole.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hweh? Nom nom nom~」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sacchin, why are you eating a roasted sweet potato in a place like this?!」
I have no idea what's going on, but Sacchin is crouched behind the utility pole, stuffing her cheeks with a piping-hot, steaming roasted sweet potato.

name: Sacchin
message: 「That hurts my feelings~ My pride as Vice President of the Sweets Club has been gravely wounded~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Precisely because it's a place like this, I eat it here~ Nom nom」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Crap, it's getting closer... I have to erase my presence! Empty mind, no thoughts...!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Chomp chomp chomp~, hot hot hot! Phew, phew!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hoh... They're really puttin' their backs into it. College kids pullin' a sweet potato cart.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, that's how it oughta be. Usin' a car for that is pure heresy.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't know the true terror of that cart, Paqy!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It went away~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Lord Synn, why've you got a face like you're sweatin' buckets?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Last winter, when that pull-cart passed by my place, I splurged big time and bought one.」

name: Synn
message: 「And then, for the entire winter, they used Grand Palace Sakura as their starting point to sell sweet potatoes...」

name: Synn
message: 「The heartache of not being able to afford one lasted all the way until spring...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sniff, sob, hic... You had such a painful past, Synn-kun~, boo-hoo」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Is that really somethin' to cry over?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sob, sniffle... nom nom munch munch~, gulp... sniff!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't eat while you're cryin'!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because it's delicious~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「In my ten-plus years of food-hopping~, the pull-cart sweet potato stand passed down as a part-time job by the nearby university's rowing club~ is number one in the whole neighborhood!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't waste your precious growing years on boring crap!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Paqy-kun, you shouldn't get mad~ You gotta eat roasted sweet potatoes more happily~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here you go~ I'll give Synn-kun half of Mister Sweet Potato~ Make sure you share it with Paqy-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-thanks! Munch, munch... delicious!」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-hey, Lord Synn, don't eat it all, alright? Share some with yours truly too. My stomach's practically sticking to my back」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe~ What are you saying with that round little belly~」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, this is Paqy's share」

name: Paqy
message: 「Grrr~, the tail end? Pretty sneaky of ya. Nom, nom, nom」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-it's good!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's even better... than last year! Did you switch to a different kind of sweet potato?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope, it's the same~ It tastes better than usual because of the spot we're in~」

name: Paqy
message: 「A place like this?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know, you know~ Like stand-up station soba noodles--they aren't actually that great, yet they taste delicious, right?~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, half the flavor of those is the atmosphere」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Roasted sweet potatoes are the exact same~ Eating them outside while hiding is the absolute best~」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. We actually have sweet potatoes planted in my family's vegetable garden too. Once we harvest them, let's make roasted sweet potatoes together」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, it's a promise~」
For a little while, Sacchin and I indulged in secretly eating roasted sweet potatoes.
...It's tasty in its own way, though if I get addicted to this, it might become a bit of a problem.
